name: Voxel Shading Pipeline
definition: The complete shading process for a hit voxel, including albedo sampling, Lambertian diffuse lighting, rim lighting, emissive handling, and specular integration.
summary: The Voxel Shading Pipeline is a per-voxel lighting model that computes illumination by rounding ray hits to discrete grid coordinates, generating per-voxel specular highlights and hard shadows.
